an5.159:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Kosambiyaṃ viharati Ghositārāme.
an5.159:1.3: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Udāyi mahatiyā gihiparisāya parivuto dhammaṃ desento nisinno hoti.
an5.159:1.4: Addasā kho āyasmā Ānando āyasmantaṃ Udāyiṃ mahatiyā gihiparisāya parivutaṃ dhammaṃ desentaṃ nisinnaṃ,
an5.159:1.5: disvā yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an5.159:1.6: ‘āyasmā bhante Udāyi mahatiyā gihiparisāya parivuto dhammaṃ desetī' ti.
an5.159:2.1: Na kho Ānanda sukaraṃ paresaṃ dhammaṃ desetuṃ.
an5.159:2.2: Paresaṃ Ānanda dhammaṃ desentena pañca dhamme ajjhattaṃ upaṭṭhāpetvā paresaṃ dhammo desetabbo.
an5.159:2.4: Anupubbikathaṃ kathessāmī ti paresaṃ dhammo desetabbo,
an5.159:2.5: pariyāyadassāvī kathaṃ kathessāmī ti paresaṃ dhammo desetabbo,
an5.159:2.6: anuddayataṃ paṭicca kathaṃ kathessāmī ti paresaṃ dhammo desetabbo,
an5.159:2.7: na āmisantaro kathaṃ kathessāmī ti paresaṃ dhammo desetabbo,
an5.159:2.8: attānañ ca parañ ca anupahacca kathaṃ kathessāmī ti paresaṃ dhammo desetabbo.
an5.159:2.9: Na kho Ānanda sukaraṃ paresaṃ dhammaṃ desetuṃ.
an5.159:2.10: Paresaṃ Ānanda dhammaṃ desentena ime pañca dhamme ajjhattaṃ upaṭṭhāpetvā paresaṃ dhammo desetabbo
